function.name: compute_sla_credit
function.description: Computes and issues an SLA uptime breach credit for a cloud tenant using zero-thinking or constrained JSON decoding. Use this tool when calculating SLA penalty credits across a monthly window in integer cents from verified outage minutes and monthly fee inputs. Do NOT use this tool for general billing SQL lookups; use query_account_ledger instead. Only credits >= 0 cents with valid YYYY-MM-DD interval bounds are accepted.

rationale.description: Concise supporting explanation of the inputs and arithmetic before emitting final values.

period_start_date.description: Inclusive ISO 8601 UTC start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the half-open interval [period_start_date, period_end_date).

period_end_date.description: Exclusive ISO 8601 UTC end date (YYYY-MM-DD) ending the half-open interval [period_start_date, period_end_date).

outage_minutes.description: Total verified unavailable minutes in [period_start_date, period_end_date), rounded to integer minutes (>= 0).

credit_cents.description: Final net SLA credit in integer cents: max(0, floor(monthly_fee_cents * tier_rate) - admin_offset_cents), rounded down to nearest cent.
